description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Grazing Kelpie.
When Grazing Kelpie dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grazing Kelpie.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
